PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). This package is model-authored (deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017); driver.lock.json keeps reviewed_by null, no human review or hardware/live run is claimed, and the clone was neither imported nor executed.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD (helper and family, not decision): the card says family ros and helper RosDriver, but the card's entry symbol gym_webots.envs.pioneer:WebotsCircuit2cPionner3atCameraNnEnv is a legacy gym.Env (gym_webots/envs/pioneer/webots_circuit2c_pioneer_camera_nn.py:28), registered as WebotsCircuit2cPioneerCameraNnEnv-v0 at gym_webots/__init__.py:10-11. Its public control interface is reset() and step(action); ROS topics and services are only the environment's internal transport to Webots (webots_env.py:58-70 and webots_circuit2c_pioneer_camera_nn.py:36-65). The package therefore uses GymnasiumDriver and preserves the environment-step interface through cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1; a RosDriver would have replaced the primary step/reset interface with a partial ROS surface. The bridge also accepts this legacy environment's bare reset return and 4-tuple step (webots_circuit2c_pioneer_camera_nn.py:227 and :279), which was exercised by the tests.

SCOPE AND SOURCES: every Fact cites the pinned commit 023ae0bebd8067ea8c7fbb4b84b31ae29a9fb9f3 in facts.md and driver.py. The upstream class defines no action_space or observation_space; step implements three actions (0 forward, 1 right, 2 left; lines 123-139) and returns a 1 x 1 x 32 x 32 grayscale frame (lines 73-75 and 226). The fake declares Discrete(3) and Box(0..255) at that real frame shape as placeholders; no action_space_ref is set because no upstream line defines a space. The reference therefore prints the derived limit as '0 .. 2; (no source: action_space of the fake backend .fake:FakeWebotsPioneerEnv)'. The fake returns the full 1 x 1 x 32 x 32 frame (1024 values), not a truncated array.

NOT COVERED: the real Webots/ROS environment (the upstream __init__ starts roscore and Webots with subprocess.Popen and needs rospy, cv2, skimage and a live ROS graph; nothing was installed or run), the camera and Sick LMS 291 arrays, the laser-window reward, the wheel velocity/position services, and installation. The fake's pixels, kinematics, collision test and reward are placeholders (F0). The upstream reward also slices LaserScan lists with laser_len/5 and laser_len/10 (lines 197-198), which are float indices under Python 3 and are not reproduced. No hardware was attached and no hardware or live-simulation run is claimed. The package declares only the fake backend, and GymnasiumDriver refuses backend 'hardware' because a simulator has no hardware backend.

EXPECTED WARNINGS from the last gate run, none failing: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed class only stores the pending seed for the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x2 for action_space and observation_space (the upstream class inherits them from gym.Env, whose base is outside the clone, and the clone's class body defines neither); G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks, action.index and the two seed fields. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. The package uses only the catalogued classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1, so there are no catalogue_requests, no site-limits.example.json (no operator-required bound) and no native.py. test_driver.py keeps the required mhs.testing.check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds seven cases (placeholder step shape, action-space envelope, seeded trajectory repeatability, seed class, collision termination and precondition, e-stop latch, published F0 fidelity); they pass. gate.digest is the digest line of the last gate run (check-report.json is regenerated and is not part of the deliverable).
